/api/agents/install: installs an agent: runs its installer (npm or the like)
/api/agents/restart: starts a stopped helper again: real agent processes
/api/agents/stop: stops or forgets helper agent processes
/api/collab/join: a team room: joins one over the network
/api/collab/leave: a team room: leaves one, telling its host
/api/collab/manage: a team room: reaches its host over the network
/api/collab/reconnect: a team room: reconnects to a host over the network
/api/collab/start: a team room: opens one, on the network
/api/collab/stop: a team room: ends one and tells its members
/api/fork: forks: clones a public decomp repository (the network, disk)
/api/fork/check: forks: checks a public decomp repository over the network
/api/fork/find-rom: forks: looks for the game's ROM on this computer's disks
/api/fork/game: forks: takes the game's own files in (disk)
/api/fork/policy: forks: reads a repository's policy over the network
/api/fork/rom-check: forks: checks a ROM against a decomp (disk, CPU)
/api/fork/setup: forks: builds a decomp project (compilers, minutes)
/api/fork/start-files: forks: starts a project from scratch (an analysis, CPU)
/api/import: streams a game upload to disk and imports it (a real import job)
/api/linux-vm: the Linux VM: a virtual machine (Windows)
/api/open: opens the project's folder on the desktop
/api/pick: opens the system's file chooser: a dialog on the desktop
/api/toolchain/all: installs every compiler of a console (big downloads)
/api/toolchain/remove: removes a local toolchain copy from disk
/api/update: installs an update and restarts the app into it
/api/window: opens the window on the desktop
